candidate.answerReason: Under the conventional independent fair six-sided dice model, there are 9 odd-odd and 9 even-even outcomes. Thus each player wins on 18 of the 36 equally likely outcomes, so the game is fair.

methods.label: Count outcomes by parity
methods.explanation: There are 36 equally likely outcomes in total. An even sum requires both numbers to have the same parity, giving 18 outcomes. There are also 18 outcomes with an odd sum. The probabilities of Player A and Player B winning are both \(1/2\), so the game is fair.
methods.levelReason: Parity and elementary counting of equally likely dice outcomes fit Grade 9 probability.
